006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.datatype;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IAnyAtomicItem;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IAtomicOrUnionType;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IItemType;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.qname.EQNameFactory;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
014import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.CollectionUtil;
015import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.CustomCollectors;
016import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
017
018import org.apache.logging.log4j.LogManager;
019import org.apache.logging.log4j.Logger;
020
021import java.util.Collection;
022import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
023import java.util.LinkedList;
024import java.util.List;
025import java.util.Map;
026import java.util.Objects;
027import java.util.ServiceLoader;
028import java.util.ServiceLoader.Provider;
029import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
030import java.util.stream.Stream;
031
032import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
033import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
034import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.SuppressFBWarnings;
035import nl.talsmasoftware.lazy4j.Lazy;
036
037/**
038 * This class provides a singleton service to allow data types to be discovered
039 * within the system based on an SPI provided by {@link IDataTypeProvider}.
040 */
041public final class DataTypeService {
042  private static final Logger LOGGER = LogManager.getLogger(DataTypeService.class);
043  private static final Lazy<DataTypeService> INSTANCE = Lazy.lazy(DataTypeService::new);
044
045  private static final List<IItemType> BUILTIN_ITEM_TYPES;
046
047  static {
048    List<IItemType> builtinItemTypes = new LinkedList<>();
049    builtinItemTypes.add(IItemType.item());
050    builtinItemTypes.add(IItemType.array());
051    builtinItemTypes.add(IItemType.map());
052    builtinItemTypes.add(IItemType.node());
053    builtinItemTypes.add(IItemType.document());
054    builtinItemTypes.add(IItemType.assembly());
055    builtinItemTypes.add(IItemType.field());
056    builtinItemTypes.add(IItemType.flag());
057    builtinItemTypes.add(IItemType.module());
058
059    BUILTIN_ITEM_TYPES = CollectionUtil.unmodifiableList(builtinItemTypes);
060  }
061
062  @NonNull
063  private final Map<Integer, IAtomicOrUnionType<?>> typeByQNameIndex;
064  @NonNull
065  private final Map<Class<? extends IDataTypeAdapter<?>>, IDataTypeAdapter<?>> atomicTypeByAdapterClass;
066  @NonNull
067  private final Map<Class<? extends IAnyAtomicItem>, IAtomicOrUnionType<?>> atomicTypeByItemClass;
068  @NonNull
069  private final Map<Class<? extends IItem>, IItemType> itemTypeByItemClass;
070
071  /**
072   * Get the singleton service instance, which will be lazy constructed on first
073   * access.
074   *
075   * @return the service instance
076   */
077  @SuppressWarnings("null")
078  @NonNull
079  public static DataTypeService instance() {
080    return INSTANCE.get();
081  }
082
083  private DataTypeService() {
084    ServiceLoader<IDataTypeProvider> loader = ServiceLoader.load(IDataTypeProvider.class);
085
086    this.atomicTypeByAdapterClass = CollectionUtil.unmodifiableMap(ObjectUtils.notNull(
087        loader.stream()
088            .map(Provider<IDataTypeProvider>::get)
089            .flatMap(provider -> provider.getJavaTypeAdapters().stream())
090            .collect(CustomCollectors.toMap(
091                dataType -> ObjectUtils.asNullableType(dataType.getClass()),
092                CustomCollectors.identity(),
093                (key, v1, v2) -> {
094                  if (LOGGER.isWarnEnabled()) {
095                    LOGGER.warn("Duplicate data type class '{}'. Using the first.",
096                        key.getClass().getName());
097                  }
098                  return v1;
099                },
100                LinkedHashMap::new))));
101
102    Stream<Map.Entry<Integer, IAtomicOrUnionType<?>>> adapterStream = this.atomicTypeByAdapterClass.values().stream()
103        .flatMap(dataType -> dataType.getNames().stream()
104            .map(qname -> Map.entry(qname.getIndexPosition(), dataType.getItemType())));
105
106    Stream<Map.Entry<Integer, IAtomicOrUnionType<?>>> abstractStream = loader.stream()
107        .map(Provider<IDataTypeProvider>::get)
108        .flatMap(provider -> provider.getAbstractTypes().stream())
109        .map(dataType -> Map.entry(dataType.getQName().getIndexPosition(), dataType));
110
111    this.typeByQNameIndex = CollectionUtil.unmodifiableMap(ObjectUtils.notNull(
112        Stream.concat(abstractStream, adapterStream)
113            .collect(CustomCollectors.toMap(
114                Map.Entry::getKey,
115                Map.Entry::getValue,
116                (key, v1, v2) -> {
117                  if (LOGGER.isWarnEnabled()) {
118                    LOGGER.warn("Duplicate data types '{}' and '{}' with name '{}'. Using the first.",
119                        v1.getClass().getName(),
120                        v2.getClass().getName(),
121                        key);
122                  }
123                  return v1;
124                },
125                ConcurrentHashMap::new))));
126
127    this.atomicTypeByItemClass = CollectionUtil.unmodifiableMap(ObjectUtils.notNull(
128        this.typeByQNameIndex.values().stream()
129            .collect(CustomCollectors.toMap(
130                type -> ObjectUtils.asNullableType(type.getItemClass()),
131                CustomCollectors.identity(),
132                (key, v1, v2) -> {
133                  if (!Objects.equals(v1, v2) && LOGGER.isWarnEnabled()) {
134                    LOGGER.warn("Duplicate atomic item class '{}' declared by types '{}' and '{}'. Using the first.",
135                        key.getName(),
136                        v1.toSignature(),
137                        v2.toSignature());
138                  }
139                  return v1;
140                },
141                ConcurrentHashMap::new))));
142
143    this.itemTypeByItemClass = CollectionUtil.unmodifiableMap(ObjectUtils.notNull(
144        Stream.concat(
145            BUILTIN_ITEM_TYPES.stream(),
146            this.atomicTypeByItemClass.values().stream())
147            .collect(CustomCollectors.toMap(
148                type -> ObjectUtils.asNullableType(type.getItemClass()),
149                CustomCollectors.identity(),
150                (key, v1, v2) -> {
151                  if (!Objects.equals(v1, v2) && LOGGER.isWarnEnabled()) {
152                    LOGGER.warn("Duplicate item class '{}' declared by types '{}' and '{}'. Using the first.",
153                        key.getName(),
154                        v1.toSignature(),
155                        v2.toSignature());
156                  }
157                  return v1;
158                },
159                ConcurrentHashMap::new))));
160  }
161
162  /**
163   * Lookup a specific {@link IAtomicOrUnionType} by its QName.
164   *
165   * @param qname
166   *          the qualified name of data type adapter to get the instance for
167   * @return the data type or {@code null} if the data type is unknown to the type
168   *         system
169   */
170  @SuppressFBWarnings(value = "NP_NULL_ON_SOME_PATH_FROM_RETURN_VALUE", justification = "false positive")
171  @Nullable
172  public IAtomicOrUnionType<?> getAtomicTypeByQName(@NonNull IEnhancedQName qname) {
173    return EQNameFactory.instance()
174        .get(qname.getIndexPosition())
175        .map(name -> getAtomicTypeByQNameIndex(name.getIndexPosition()))
176        .orElse(null);
177  }
178
179  /**
180   * Lookup a specific {@link IAtomicOrUnionType} by its QName index position.
181   *
182   * @param qnameIndexPosition
183   *          the position in the global QName index for the qualified name of
184   *          data type adapter to get the instance for
185   * @return the data type or {@code null} if the data type is unknown to the type
186   *         system
187   */
188  @Nullable
189  public IAtomicOrUnionType<?> getAtomicTypeByQNameIndex(int qnameIndexPosition) {
190    return typeByQNameIndex.get(qnameIndexPosition);
191  }
192
193  /**
194   * Lookup a specific {@link IAtomicOrUnionType} by its item class.
195   *
196   * @param <T>
197   *          the Java type of the atomic item handled by this class
198   * @param clazz
199   *          the adapter class to get the instance for
200   * @return the data type or {@code null} if the data type is unknown to the type
201   *         system
202   */
203  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
204  @Nullable
205  public <T extends IAnyAtomicItem> IAtomicOrUnionType<T> getAtomicTypeByItemClass(Class<T> clazz) {
206    return (IAtomicOrUnionType<T>) atomicTypeByItemClass.get(clazz);
207  }
208
209  /**
210   * Lookup a specific {@link IAtomicOrUnionType} by its item class.
211   *
212   * @param clazz
213   *          the adapter class to get the instance for
214   * @return the data type or {@code null} if the data type is unknown to the type
215   *         system
216   */
217  @Nullable
218  public IItemType getItemTypeByItemClass(Class<? extends IItem> clazz) {
219    return itemTypeByItemClass.get(clazz);
220  }
221
222  /**
223   * Get the collection of all registered data type adapters provided by this
224   * service.
225   * <p>
226   * The returned collection is unmodifiable.
227   *
228   * @return the data type adapters
229   */
230  @NonNull
231  public Collection<? extends IDataTypeAdapter<?>> getDataTypes() {
232    return ObjectUtils.notNull(atomicTypeByAdapterClass.values());
233  }
234
235  /**
236   * Lookup a specific {@link IDataTypeAdapter} by its adapter class.
237   *
238   * @param clazz
239   *          the adapter class to get the instance for
240   * @param <TYPE>
241   *          the type of the requested adapter
242   * @return the adapter or {@code null} if the adapter is unknown to the type
243   *         system
244   */
245  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
246  @Nullable
247  public <TYPE extends IDataTypeAdapter<?>> TYPE getDataTypeByAdapterClass(
248      @NonNull Class<TYPE> clazz) {
249    return (TYPE) atomicTypeByAdapterClass.get(clazz);
250  }
251}
